title: ubilink integration manifest
description: Declares a third-party integration: its identity, the app it links, and the capabilities it needs. Satisfies RT-6 (a manifest schema lets plugins declare capabilities, granted per-integration; the broker enforces the grant) and feeds TN1's capability broker. See .manifold/linking-manifesto-app.md

name.description: Human-readable integration name shown in the grant/consent UI.

app.description: The target application this integration links (e.g. Obsidian).

version.description: Semantic version of the integration; updatable independently of core (T4).

needs.description: Capability strings the integration declares it needs. Granted per-integration; the broker enforces the grant (RT-6, TN1). Grammar: '<verb>:<scope>'. A scheme-prefix scope ending in '://' (e.g. 'open:obsidian://') authorizes any request under that scheme. NO wildcard semantics: there is no capability string that yields the link graph wholesale (S1).

signature.description: Detached signature over the bundle for provenance (S2). Placeholder in this spike; null/absent is accepted but unsigned bundles SHOULD be rejected by policy in production.
